subject: Discrepancy in the Section 26 27 26 receptacle mounting height between Electrical Detail

messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 27 26 receptacle mounting height between Sheet E-501 and Electrical Detail 2/E502 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication? This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. No cost impact is anticipated. This could affect the electrical rough-in schedule. Please respond at your earliest convenience. We can't tie this to a firm date on our end -- it depends on when the panel vendor gets back to us, and they haven't given a timeline.

Sheet E-501 governs for the Section 26 27 26 receptacle mounting height near DP-3; Electrical Detail 2/E502 will be superseded by an updated drawing. No cost impact is anticipated. This could affect the electrical rough-in schedule.
